title: Effect of Fish Oil on Adiposity and Atherogenic Factors in Type 2 Diabetic Women

sections.abstract: 1. whether the intake of n-3 PUFA has additional effects on insulin sensitivity and adiposity (total fat mass and adipocyte morphology and function) in T2D women. 2. n-3 PUFA supplementation might influence inflammatory genes expression in the adipose tissue of T2D patients.
